overloadMerges.note: Corrected direction: missingTables is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in.

params.name: missingTables
params.description: Names of tables whose data exists in the data file but are not defined in the current structure (e.g. after opening the data file with a newer structure that dropped them).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the names of tables present in the data file but missing from the current structure, so they can be reactivated with REGENERATE MISSING TABLE.
